evidence: Function-only after 0082: no table, column, policy, grant or applied migration is removed or rewritten; the code at the W02 release keeps working on the new schema. 0083 replaces ehr.patient_self_context(uuid) with the same signature and result; CREATE OR REPLACE keeps its owner and EXECUTE grants, so every patient-self policy (0030, 0033, 0061, 0066, 0067 and lab.patient_self_context, 0068, 0069) is unchanged. It becomes SECURITY DEFINER with search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp, keeps every setting check, and also requires the named patient, account, subject and session to match a live, unrevoked patient session of an active account and patient (the conditions of identity.patient_self_session, inline). Real patient contexts from Identity's self authorization keep reading; a context naming another patient or a revoked, expired, stale or non-existent session reads nothing. Measured on PostgreSQL 16: 25 microseconds per row of the patient's own records against 7 before (main's nested form: about 500), and about the same end-to-end time for the records summary and patient evidence queries. Built 0001-0083 in production order (0001-0072, role bootstrap, then 0073-0083) and in new-installation order; every suite in services/ehr-api/database/tests and services/ehr-api/test/database passes, the new binding suite fails at 0082 and passes at 0083, and test-patient-evidence-runtime.mjs, test-patient-chat-history.mjs, test-platform-administration.mjs and test-notification-recipient.mjs pass. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence.
